status: UNAUDITED prototype. Global risk and fee parameters proposed by agent 392; reasons and sources in docs/MARKETS.md. Values marked TBD-owner need the owner's money or decision.

global.withdrawalFeeUnit: USDC (decimal string), flat, deducted from the gross Withdraw.amount (SPEC S-9.2)
global.minFeeSweepUnit: USDC; PROTOCOL_FEE balance swept daily to feeRecipient when at least this (SPEC S-9.3)

feeTiers.window: rolling 14 UTC days of the account's own taker + maker notional (agents count toward their main account)
feeTiers.status: PROPOSAL for SPEC open item O-4 (volume tiers). SPEC v0.1 applies tier 0 to everyone until 388 adds tiers.
feeTiers.rebates: none (maker fee never below 0 in v0.2)

inflows: liquidation fees (liquidationFeePpm of liquidated notional, from remaining equity, never below 0)
outflows: deficits of accounts liquidated past bankruptcy (SPEC 6.3 step 5)
insuranceFund.seedUnit: USDC; formula and per-market terms in docs/MARKETS.md section 5; computed 57241 by compliance/tools/check_params.py at the oiCap values of markets.json 0.2.0 and the 2026-11-17 reference prices, rounded up to the next 5000 for price drift
insuranceFund.withdrawals: none: the insurance fund has no key and no withdrawal path in v0.2 (a change needs a new genesis)
insuranceFund.launchGate: trading does not open (markets stay halted) until INSURANCE.balance >= seedRequired and BACKSTOP equity >= its seed (go/no-go item; engine enforcement is a request to 388)
insuranceFund.oiCapRule: raising an oiCap requires INSURANCE.balance >= sum over markets of oiCapUsd(m) * max(0, stress1hBps(m) - mmfBps_tier0(m)) / 10000 at the new caps (checked off-chain at genesis/upgrade by tools; engine enforcement is a request to 388)

backstop.role: takes the part of a liquidation the book did not fill, at the bankruptcy price, only while its own equity covers its own maintenance requirement (SPEC 6.3 step 3); else ADL
backstop.seedProposal: at least 25% of the largest single-market oiCap notional at tier-0 IMF: 25% of the BTC-USD oiCap notional (0.25 * 1945745 = 486436 USDC at the 2026-11-17 reference price) at the tier-0 IMF of 5% needs 24322 USDC: proposed seed 25000 USDC
backstop.positionLimitPerMarket: the backstop takes over at most 25% of oiCap(m) in any market (proposal to 388; above it, ADL)
backstop.unwind: proposal to 388: the backstop's positions are offered as reduce-only limit orders at mark +/- markBandBps; never at a loss beyond its own bankruptcy
backstop.profitsTo: stay in BACKSTOP (capacity); no owner withdrawal path in v0.2

adl.rule: SPEC 6.4: last resort only, after the book and the backstop; ranking profitRatio * leverage; every ADL fill is an event naming both accounts; disclosed in compliance/legal/risk-disclosure.md

invariantsChecked: R-2 every imfPpm = 2 * mmfPpm (Decided: maintenance = half of initial, the convention of both benchmarks), rounded up for odd values
R-3 tiers ascending in floor, imf and mmf non-decreasing
R-4 maxLeverage = floor(10^6 / imfPpm of tier 0)
R-5 maxFundingRate * 24 < (imfPpm - mmfPpm of tier 0) * 1000 (funding alone cannot move a position from initial to maintenance within one day)
R-6 mmfPpm of tier 0 >= stress1hBps * 100 / 2 (maintenance covers at least half of the worst observed one-hour adverse move on either venue; the rest is the insurance fund's)
R-7 minSize * reference price >= 10 USD, a multiple of step; maxSize <= oiCap; tick and step exact in the fixed scales
R-8 takerFeePpm >= makerFeePpm >= 0 at every fee tier; tier 0 equals markets.json fees
